skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and distinguish key concepts between financial institutions, banks, non-bank financial institutions, commercial banks, cooperative banks, policy banks, finance companies, leasing companies, and credit unions.
Understand the functions of banks and their main services.
Understand and apply simple interest calculation methods in commercial banking operations.
Understand and apply compound interest calculation methods in commercial banking operations.
Understand the concept, forms of capital raising, and management of bank capital sources.
Understand the concept, types of bank assets, and asset management practices.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Case Analysis on Bank Asset Management
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze real-world cases on bank asset management.
